# Draft tiered waitlist emails

I run a new practice with 30 clinical hours per week and see 20 patients. I want modest revenue growth, sustainability, and flexibility. Create three email templates for a tiered waitlist: Tier 1 (immediate slot), Tier 2 (available in 2 weeks), Tier 3 (available in 4 weeks). Each template should include a greeting, brief status update, next‑step instructions, and a sign‑off. Return the three drafts separated by clear headings.
